title: Bogie-hearth hood furnaces: loading space and hood interlocks
summary: Hood lifting and bogie travel need joint space and interlock checks. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s two bogie-hearth hood-furnace proposals dated 5 October 2023 concern cylindrical and tubular workpieces. They permit heating after the hood is compressed into position, disconnect heating as it rises, and permit bogie travel only once it is fully raised. These relationships are useful references, but do not establish inclusion of workpiece lifting, immersion or a complete quenching cycle.
